sources.citation: Neto, E. C. P., Dadkhah, S., Ferreira, R., Zohourian, A., Lu, R., and Ghorbani, A. A. (2023). CICIoT2023: A Real-Time Dataset and Benchmark for Large-Scale Attacks in IoT Environment. Sensors, 23(13), 5941.
Canadian Institute for Cybersecurity. CIC IoT Dataset 2023: data descriptions and official supplementary downloads.
CICIoT2023 supplementary pcap2csv feature-extraction source distributed from the official dataset page (local archive SHA-256 1AB24F2A4373ACBDAC08E6835F07BC87DA472390D5658524B63DE5E3E084B4AC).

feature_groups.name: Header_Length
feature_groups.definition: Mean transport-layer header length across the extractor's packet aggregation window; UDP uses its fixed header length and TCP includes options.
feature_groups.admissible_range: Nonnegative real value after window aggregation; exact observed values are not supplied.

feature_groups.name: Protocol Type
feature_groups.definition: Modal IP protocol-number value across the packet aggregation window.
feature_groups.admissible_range: Integer from 0 through 255 before preprocessing; exact observed values are not supplied.

feature_groups.name: Time_To_Live
feature_groups.definition: Mean IP time-to-live field across the packet aggregation window; this corresponds to the paper's Duration/TTL feature.
feature_groups.admissible_range: Real value from 0 through 255 after window aggregation.

feature_groups.name: Rate
feature_groups.definition: Packet count divided by the elapsed time of the aggregation window.
feature_groups.admissible_range: Nonnegative real value when the window duration is positive; exact observed values are not supplied.

feature_groups.name: fin_flag_number
feature_groups.definition: Window-aggregated indicator for the TCP FIN control flag.

feature_groups.name: syn_flag_number
feature_groups.definition: Window-aggregated indicator for the TCP SYN control flag.

feature_groups.name: rst_flag_number
feature_groups.definition: Window-aggregated indicator for the TCP RST control flag.

feature_groups.name: psh_flag_number
feature_groups.definition: Window-aggregated indicator for the TCP PSH control flag.

feature_groups.name: ack_flag_number
feature_groups.definition: Window-aggregated indicator for the TCP ACK control flag.

feature_groups.name: ece_flag_number
feature_groups.definition: Window-aggregated indicator for the TCP ECE control flag.

feature_groups.name: cwr_flag_number
feature_groups.definition: Window-aggregated indicator for the TCP CWR control flag.

feature_groups.name: ack_count
feature_groups.definition: Aggregated count-like value for packets carrying the TCP ACK flag in the window.
feature_groups.admissible_range: Nonnegative numeric value after aggregation; exact observed values are not supplied.

feature_groups.name: syn_count
feature_groups.definition: Aggregated count-like value for packets carrying the TCP SYN flag in the window.
feature_groups.admissible_range: Nonnegative numeric value after aggregation; exact observed values are not supplied.

feature_groups.name: fin_count
feature_groups.definition: Aggregated count-like value for packets carrying the TCP FIN flag in the window.
feature_groups.admissible_range: Nonnegative numeric value after aggregation; exact observed values are not supplied.

feature_groups.name: rst_count
feature_groups.definition: Aggregated count-like value for packets carrying the TCP RST flag in the window.
feature_groups.admissible_range: Nonnegative numeric value after aggregation; exact observed values are not supplied.

feature_groups.name: HTTP
feature_groups.definition: Window-aggregated indicator for traffic using the extractor's HTTP port rule.

feature_groups.name: HTTPS
feature_groups.definition: Window-aggregated indicator for traffic using the extractor's HTTPS port rule.

feature_groups.name: DNS
feature_groups.definition: Window-aggregated indicator for traffic using the extractor's DNS port rule.

feature_groups.name: Telnet
feature_groups.definition: Window-aggregated indicator for traffic using the extractor's Telnet port rule.

feature_groups.name: SMTP
feature_groups.definition: Window-aggregated indicator for traffic using the extractor's SMTP port rule.

feature_groups.name: SSH
feature_groups.definition: Window-aggregated indicator for traffic using the extractor's SSH port rule.

feature_groups.name: IRC
feature_groups.definition: Window-aggregated indicator labelled IRC by the dataset; the supplied supplementary extractor implements this label with a port-21 rule, so it must not be interpreted as a protocol-perfect IRC detector.

feature_groups.name: TCP
feature_groups.definition: Window-aggregated indicator that the IP payload is TCP.

feature_groups.name: UDP
feature_groups.definition: Window-aggregated indicator that the IP payload is UDP.

feature_groups.name: DHCP
feature_groups.definition: Window-aggregated indicator for traffic matching the extractor's DHCP port-pair rule.

feature_groups.name: ARP
feature_groups.definition: Window-aggregated indicator for Address Resolution Protocol traffic.

feature_groups.name: ICMP
feature_groups.definition: Window-aggregated indicator for Internet Control Message Protocol traffic.

feature_groups.name: IGMP
feature_groups.definition: Window-aggregated indicator for Internet Group Management Protocol traffic.

feature_groups.name: IPv
feature_groups.definition: Window-aggregated indicator for IP traffic in the extractor's layered feature set.

feature_groups.name: LLC
feature_groups.definition: Field labelled as a window-aggregated Logical Link Control indicator; the supplied supplementary extractor uses a type-check expression that appears constant-like, so semantic interpretation requires caution.
feature_groups.admissible_range: Real value from 0 through 1 after aggregation.

feature_groups.name: Tot sum
feature_groups.definition: Sum of Ethernet frame sizes within the packet aggregation window.
feature_groups.admissible_range: Nonnegative real value; exact observed values are not supplied.

feature_groups.name: Min
feature_groups.definition: Minimum Ethernet frame size within the packet aggregation window.
feature_groups.admissible_range: Nonnegative real value; exact observed values are not supplied.

feature_groups.name: Max
feature_groups.definition: Maximum Ethernet frame size within the packet aggregation window.
feature_groups.admissible_range: Nonnegative real value; exact observed values are not supplied.

feature_groups.name: AVG
feature_groups.definition: Arithmetic mean Ethernet frame size within the packet aggregation window.
feature_groups.admissible_range: Nonnegative real value; exact observed values are not supplied.

feature_groups.name: Std
feature_groups.definition: Sample standard deviation of Ethernet frame sizes within the packet aggregation window.
feature_groups.admissible_range: Nonnegative real value; exact observed values are not supplied.

feature_groups.name: Tot size
feature_groups.definition: Mean Ethernet frame size retained by the window aggregation step.
feature_groups.admissible_range: Nonnegative real value; exact observed values are not supplied.

feature_groups.name: IAT
feature_groups.definition: Mean elapsed time between consecutive accepted packets in the aggregation window.
feature_groups.admissible_range: Nonnegative real value; exact observed values are not supplied.

feature_groups.name: Number
feature_groups.definition: Number of packets represented by the aggregation window.
feature_groups.admissible_range: Positive integer for a nonempty window; exact observed values are not supplied.

feature_groups.name: Variance
feature_groups.definition: Sample variance of Ethernet frame sizes within the packet aggregation window.
feature_groups.admissible_range: Nonnegative real value; exact observed values are not supplied.

classes.name: benign
classes.description: Normal IoT traffic without one of the dataset's 33 attack labels.

classes.name: brute_force
classes.description: Dictionary-based brute-force attack traffic in the dataset's Brute Force category.

classes.name: ddos
classes.description: Distributed denial-of-service traffic covering the dataset's ACK fragmentation, UDP flood, SlowLoris, ICMP flood, RSTFIN flood, PSHACK flood, HTTP flood, UDP fragmentation, TCP flood, SYN flood, SynonymousIP flood, and ICMP fragmentation scenarios.

classes.name: dos
classes.description: Single-source denial-of-service traffic covering TCP, HTTP, SYN, and UDP flood scenarios.

classes.name: mirai
classes.description: Traffic from the dataset's Mirai GREIP flood, GRE Ethernet flood, and UDPPlain scenarios.

classes.name: recon
classes.description: Reconnaissance traffic covering ping sweep, operating-system scan, vulnerability scan, port scan, and host discovery scenarios.

classes.name: spoofing
classes.description: Spoofing traffic covering ARP-spoofing and DNS-spoofing scenarios.

classes.name: web_based
classes.description: Web-oriented attack traffic covering SQL injection, command injection, backdoor malware, uploading attack, cross-site scripting, and browser hijacking scenarios.
